_note: Template. install.ps1 (or first plugin load) copies this to config.json and fills the real paths. Keys: comfyRoot=ComfyUI portable root or a plain ComfyUI clone dir; pythonExe=python.exe used to run expander.py; workDir=runtime logs and caches; cardsDir=role-card JSON dir scanned by /cards; outputDir=ComfyUI output dir; allowLan=true lets sidecar accept requests from private-LAN pages (default false = localhost only).
